digest.component_or_area: agentic execution mode, prompt caching configuration
propositions: On the agentic execution path, accumulated tool-result message history is re-sent uncached on every turn, causing input costs to grow O(N^2) with the number of turns while remaining invisible to rebar's cache telemetry

cache_settings_for only activates two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) and explicitly does not set anthropic_cache_messages or anthropic_cache itself, leaving the growing message tail uncached

The telemetry predicate warn_if_cache_ineffective fails to fire on this scenario because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero even though the message tail carries the actual O(N^2) waste

Multi-turn message-tail caching requires different cache keys between Anthropic (anthropic_cache=True) and Bedrock (bedrock_cache_messages=True) due to provider-specific constraints, and Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical to prevent regression, requiring execution_mode to be threaded into cache_settings_for to apply tail caching only to agentic mode
